dict.string: Atelier needs to control Music and Spotify to show what is playing and to let you play, pause, and skip tracks from the notch.
Atelier taps system audio to drive the live waveform visualizer that reacts to whatever's actually playing.
Atelier watches for your AirPods connecting so it can show a quick peek with the model and battery level in the notch.
Atelier shows a live mirror of your camera in the notch. The camera is only on while the mirror is showing, and nothing is recorded or saved.
Atelier reads your calendar to show your week and upcoming events in the notch. It never changes or adds events.
Atelier uses your approximate location, once in a while, to show the weather in the notch. It is only used to ask a weather service for a forecast.
